resources.string: Show a small floating screenshot button. A tap captures the screen; a long press scrolls and combines screenshots. Only scroll-area geometry is inspected; no app text is stored or sent.

Screen captures stay on your device · No tracking. Internet is used only to check GitHub releases when enabled or requested. No screenshot or app text is uploaded. Pictures go to Pictures/FloatShot.
Long screenshots work best on vertically scrolling pages. Protected screens and certain apps cannot be captured.

Checks GitHub Releases over HTTPS only, at most once every 24 hours while opening the app. Turn off automatic checks anytime. Installing updates is always your choice.
